llmsFull.body:
# Marco Polo - Complete Information Guide

## About Marco Polo
title: Marco Polo - Asynchronous Video Messaging App
url: https://www.marcopolo.me
description: Marco Polo is a video messaging app that lets you connect with family and friends on your schedule. Unlike live video calls, Marco Polo allows you to send video messages that can be watched and replied to at any time. No ads, no algorithms, no social media pressure - just authentic connections.

## Company Information
company: Joya Communications Inc.
founders: Vlada and Michal Bortnik
founded: 2014
mission: Helping people feel close to one another
values: Privacy-first, family-friendly, authentic connections
wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marco_Polo_(app)
wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q48814451

## Core Features
- Asynchronous video messaging: Send and receive video messages on your own schedule
- Group conversations: Create groups for family, friends, clubs, or communities
- No time limits: Videos can be as long or short as you want
- Saves all videos: Keep your memories forever
- Voice notes: Send quick audio messages when video isn't convenient
- Text messages: Add text when needed
- Photo sharing: Share photos alongside your video messages
- Emoji reactions: React to messages with emojis
- Privacy controls: Control who can contact you and see your content
- No ads: Completely ad-free experience
- Cross-platform: Works on iOS, Android, and web

## Marco Polo Plus Premium Features
subscription: Marco Polo Plus
pricing: Visit https://www.marcopolo.me/plus for current pricing
features:
- Speed control: Watch videos at 1.5x or 2x speed
- Background listening: Keep listening when you leave the app
- Custom emoji reactions: Create personalized reactions
- Voice-only mode: Send voice messages without video
- Scrubbing: Skip through videos to specific moments
- Plus Passes: Share premium features with others temporarily
- Priority support: Get help faster

## Use Cases & Benefits

### For Families
- Stay connected across distances and time zones
- Share daily moments without scheduling calls
- Create family groups for different sides of the family
- Save precious memories of children growing up
- Perfect for military families with deployment schedules

### For Friends
- Maintain friendships despite busy schedules
- Share experiences without social media pressure
- Create groups for book clubs, sports teams, or hobbies
- No FOMO - watch messages when convenient

### For Communities
- Connect church groups and congregations
- Support groups and recovery communities
- School communities and parent groups
- Neighborhood watch and local communities

### For Business & Teams
- Remote team check-ins
- Asynchronous standup meetings
- Client communication and updates
- Real estate walkthroughs
- Coaching and mentoring

## Unique Advantages
- No scheduling required: Connect on your own time
- No social media features: No likes, followers, or public profiles
- Privacy-focused: Your data is never sold or used for ads
- Family-friendly: Safe for all ages
- Unlimited video length: No time restrictions
- Saves everything: Never lose important messages
- Works globally: Connect with anyone, anywhere

## Awards & Recognition
- Featured by Apple App Store multiple times
- Google Play Editor's Choice
- Recommended by military family organizations
- Praised by parenting magazines and blogs
- High user retention and satisfaction rates
